changelog:
收取节奏自动化与后台保活（1.6.2）

🔔 空闲改用长轮询，服务端有货即返回；新增实时唤醒通道，锁屏后台也能尽快收到。
🔋 实时唤醒健康时不再常驻唤醒锁，空闲请求与耗电明显下降。
🛠️ 被系统回收或划掉最近任务后 1 秒自动尝试重启；保活引导新增「允许关联启动」。
⚙️ 移除「收取间隔」滑杆：节奏自动决定；旧备份可恢复但不再生效。
⚠️ 实时唤醒需最新服务端；旧服务端自动退回长轮询，不影响收消息。
changelogEn:
Automatic receiving cadence and background delivery (1.6.2)

🔔 Idle receiving now uses long polling and returns as soon as the server has mail; a real-time wake-up channel keeps messages arriving promptly behind a locked screen.
🔋 No permanent wake lock while the wake-up channel is healthy — idle requests and battery use drop noticeably.
🛠️ Automatically attempts a restart 1 second after the system reclaims the service or you swipe the task away; the keep-alive guide now includes "allow associated start".
⚙️ The poll-interval slider is gone; cadence is automatic. An old backup can restore it, but it no longer takes effect.
⚠️ The wake-up channel needs the latest server; older servers fall back to long polling automatically, so delivery still works.
